rows.label: tlk70000045_05_msg0001
rows.name:
Azzaro is upset that Rikoko didn't say
Rikoko was a Nopon, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000045_05_msg0002
rows.name:
Rikoko is a proper lady, you know. How
rude, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000045_05_msg0003
rows.name:
But he praised Rikoko's flute for its
beautiful tone, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000045_05_msg0004
rows.name:
Azzaro isn't very honest, but he's
always serious about performing, so
it's fun being with him, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000045_05_msg0005
rows.name:
Rikoko will study all kinds of things
here and become a fine traveling
performer someday, mo!
